headlines.title: What Could Netflix (NFLX) Gain From Owning The Radford Studio Center?
headlines.summary: Netflix (NasdaqGS:NFLX) is in advanced talks to acquire the Radford Studio Center in Los Angeles, according to recent reports. The Radford Studio Center is a long established Hollywood production lot that currently hosts multiple television and film projects. This would be Netflix's first purchase of a full scale studio campus in California, shifting it from tenant to owner operator.

headlines.title: NFLX Stock Edges Lower Overnight: Streaming Giant Buys Historic ‘Seinfeld’ Studio Lot In Reported $380M Deal
headlines.summary: While Netflix did not disclose the deal value, according to a report from Los Angeles Times, the purchase was completed at a value of $380 million.

description: Netflix, Inc. provides entertainment services worldwide. The company offers television (TV) series, documentaries, feature films, games, and live programming across various genres and languages. It also provides members the ability to receive streaming content through a host of internet-connected devices, including TVs, digital video players, TV set-top boxes, and mobile devices. Netflix, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, California.
